theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라

theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트

top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set to Rise as Oil Eases, Yen Gains: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian stocks were poised to follow Wall Street higher, while oil slipped after President Donald Trump played down the prospect of a prolonged conflict with Iran. The yen strengthened.

top_news.title: Japan’s 30-Year Bond Auction Risks Adding Fuel to Debt Selloff
top_news.summary: Japan’s 30-year government bond auction Thursday will test investor appetite as a global selloff pushes long-dated yields to their highest levels in almost two decades.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 3
top_news.summary: Oil steadied after a three-day rally as President Donald Trump said renewed attacks on Iran would be short-lived while reiterating his claim that the US controls the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Malaysia Johor Regent TMJ’s Plan to Sell Singapore Land Clouded by Huge Tax Bill
top_news.summary: A Malaysian royal’s plan to sell a tract of land in the heart of Singapore faces a complication: a tax bill that may exceed $1 billion.

top_news.title: Five Below Lifts Outlook, Aims to Ramp Up Appeal to Gen Alpha
top_news.summary: Five Below Inc. shares rose over 8% in postmarket trading on Wednesday after the retailer lifted its full-year outlook, citing the addition of new stores and the popularity of its budget-friendly merchandise among Gen Alpha and Gen Z shoppers.

top_news.title: NBA Suspends Clippers Owner Ballmer After Leonard Salary Probe
top_news.summary: The NBA stripped the Los Angeles Clippers of five first-round draft picks and suspended owner Steve Ballmer for one year after finding the team had circumvented salary cap rules by facilitating sponsorship agreements between outside companies and star player Kawhi Leonard. Randall Williams reports on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Shaquille O’Neal Kicks off College Tour on Credit
top_news.summary: Shaquille O'Neal, 15-time NBA All-Star, joins Romaine Bostick on 'The Close' to discuss his 'Credit Tip Off Tour' with Credit One Bank to educate students about building credit. He also gets into his latest venture as a DJ. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Deadly Flooding in Nepal Highlights Asia’s Climate Vulnerability
top_news.summary: On today’s Big Take Asia podcast: The latest on Nepal’s deadly floods and how the disaster could undermine the country’s burgeoning hydropower ambitions.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Australian Earnings Beat Estimates for First Time in Four Years
top_news.summary: Australian earnings beats are outpacing misses for the first time in four years, defying a challenging economic backdrop and bolstering chances for a stalled stock rally to resume.

top_news.title: Japanese Companies Consider Asset Sales as Yen Debt Costs Rise
top_news.summary: Japanese companies are expanding their toolkit to deal with the steepest borrowing costs in a generation, including considering sales of strategic shareholdings and other assets to offset the impact, a Bloomberg News survey shows.
